hypothesis: Confirmed setter or attacker availability and predecision team serve/reception history may improve match-win log loss compared with same-time market and a no-fact baseline.
units: One unique match and identical full-match two-way product, quote and settlement. Set markets and rally-point totals are separate products and excluded.
decision: Freeze actual recorded receipts at or before the earlier of actual decision and scheduled start minus 30 minutes. Require unambiguous identity, complete predecision two-way quote and official settled result. No imputed receipt times.
features: official confirmed setter and attacker presence or absence, source revision and actual receipt
prior completed matches official serve errors, aces, reception and set scores with actual availability
candidate: Single regularized logistic market-offset model with fixed L2 penalty 10; home no-vig market logit offset, home-minus-away confirmed setter absence and attacker absence indicators, and predecision team serve/reception differential. Unknown facts remain missing; no manual probability bonus. Require both teams observed for each variable; otherwise no candidate prediction.
split: Prospective chronological, by match date; first 60% eligible matches train, next 20% validation, final 20% test. Boundaries fixed by sequence before opening labels; no same-date split. Minimum 200 train, 50 validation, 100 test with at least 30 confirmed affected matches overall and 10 in each validation and test. Otherwise blocked_data. Training labels must have actual receipt before each split starts. No refits on test.
selection: Exactly one candidate; compare candidate against no-fact market-offset intercept-only model and no-vig market. Proceed to test only if validation candidate paired mean log loss is strictly lower than both comparators; no tuning or test-driven revision. Frozen operating picks are a separate comparison only where exact matching revisions exist; never substitute reconstructed picks.
stop: Stop if eligibility, receipt provenance, sample minimum, label availability or identity checks fail, or validation gate fails. Negative or inconclusive test is reported without promotion. A new protocol requires a new commit and fresh future data.
reports: opportunities and exclusion reasons by market
actual predecision receipt, complete price, result and confirmed player link counts
future-label poisoning, time leakage and duplicate-document checks
integrity: Document bytes and actual receipt provenance required; SHA256 alone is not independent authentication. Published time is not receipt. Probable is not confirmed. Duplicate bytes count once as evidence, not as proof of shared authorship. No target-game outcomes in features. Freeze training labels by actual availability and test future-label poisoning in Python when data exists.
